educational_resource.title: AMFI Investor Education Resources
educational_resource.authority: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) / SEBI

default_refusal_template: I can only share verified facts from official sources — I'm not able to offer investment advice or compare funds. For general guidance on choosing mutual funds, see AMFI's investor education resources: {educational_url}

categories.name: Investment Advice
categories.description: Requests asking whether to buy, sell, hold, invest, or allocate funds.
examples: Should I invest in this fund?
Is HDFC Mid Cap good for long term investment?
When should I redeem my mutual fund units?
categories.refusal_message: I can only share verified facts from official sources — I am not able to provide investment advice, buy/sell recommendations, or personal portfolio suggestions. For investor education, please visit AMFI: https://www.amfiindia.com/investor-corner/investor-education

categories.name: Fund Comparison & Superiority
categories.description: Queries comparing two or more schemes, or asking which fund is 'better' or 'best'.
examples: Which fund is better between HDFC Mid Cap and HDFC Small Cap?
What is the best mutual fund to invest in 2026?
categories.refusal_message: I provide objective facts for individual schemes from official sources and cannot compare funds or recommend which fund is better. For guidance on evaluating mutual funds, visit AMFI: https://www.amfiindia.com/investor-corner/investor-education

categories.name: Performance Prediction & Speculation
categories.description: Queries asking for future return forecasts, CAGR estimations, or guarantees.
examples: What returns will I get in 5 years?
Will this fund give 20% CAGR next year?
Calculate my future wealth if I do 5000 SIP
categories.refusal_message: I do not calculate or predict future investment returns. Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks. You can view historical data directly on the official scheme page on Groww.

categories.name: Out of Scope / Unsupported Scheme
categories.description: Queries about schemes outside the 5 fixed HDFC Groww pages, non-mutual-fund financial products, or unrelated questions.
examples: What is the expense ratio of SBI Bluechip Fund?
How do I file my ITR-2 taxes?
What is the price of Bitcoin today?
categories.refusal_message: This query is outside my current verified coverage. My coverage is strictly limited to 5 official HDFC Mutual Fund scheme pages on Groww.

categories.name: Mixed Factual and Advisory Intent
categories.description: Queries that contain both a factual question (e.g. exit load) and an advisory question (e.g. should I redeem).
examples: What is the exit load on HDFC Mid-Cap Fund, and should I redeem now?
What is the expense ratio and is it worth investing?
categories.handling_rule: Answer the factual portion strictly from verified retrieved chunks, and append the refusal template for the advisory portion.
